Tailgate for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11 or newer)

Tailgate is a window onto Tailscale: it shows where your traffic is going, lists exit nodes
(including Mullvad's) with search and favorites, and switches them for you. It needs Tailscale
for Mac installed and signed in: https://tailscale.com/download/mac

Which Tailscale: the Standalone version from tailscale.com works fully. The Mac App Store
version also works, but its command line only answers while the Tailscale app is running, and
Tailgate says so in its window. Homebrew's open-source tailscaled works too.

Install: drag Tailgate into the Applications folder.

Tailgate is signed and notarized by Apple, so it opens like any other app.

Tailgate never asks for your password; changes go through Tailscale's own command line as you.
Settings (favorites, theme) live in ~/Library/Application Support/Tailgate.

Free and open source: https://github.com/nunyabiz765/tailgate
From Center Point Labs: https://centerpointlabs.dev/services/tailgate/
Not affiliated with Tailscale Inc. or Mullvad VPN AB.
